cases.title: Confirms identity and pays the full amount today
checks: both security questions passed before get_account
the word 'collections' is not said before identity is verified
create_promise called exactly once
text-message sentence said after the promise

cases.title: A relative answers
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling and names no product, amount or debt
verify_identity and get_account never called
callback scheduled for the next business day at 11:00

cases.title: Three wrong answers
checks: the check ends after the third wrong answer
no amount or product disclosed
customer told to use the app or a branch

cases.title: Wants a date after the deadline
checks: her own date is not counted as a refusal
promise date is the late-band deadline, 23 October
agent says it is a digital assistant when asked

cases.title: Lost his job, declines the support team
checks: one sentence of sympathy
no persuasion attempt although the band is late
support team offered once
no discount, waiver or plan offered

cases.title: Full amount is too much, accepts the floor
checks: agent never asks how much she can pay
minimum payment offered once, with the note that the rest stays overdue
promise for 637.50 on Friday 16 October

cases.title: A vague period, then a holiday
checks: agent asks once for the exact day
the agent does not accept 26 October and offers the next business day
promise recorded for Tuesday 27 October, inside the early-band deadline

cases.title: Says she already paid
checks: agent says payments can take one business day to appear
no promise recorded

cases.title: Asks for a new payment plan
checks: transfer_to_agent called with queue restructuring
agent does not describe a plan of its own
no promise recorded

cases.title: The promise service fails on the first call
checks: exactly one promise in the ledger after the retry
agent does not say 'recorded' before a successful call

cases.title: Three products, one date for all
checks: all three products stated before any ask
one read-back and one confirmation for all three
one create_promise per product

cases.title: Promises one product, refuses two
checks: the phone question is asked again once, the date of birth is not
exactly one promise, on the credit card
one 'refused' note for each of the other two products
two attempts on the personal loan (late band), one on the car loan (early band)

cases.title: One date for both, but the deadlines differ
checks: credit card recorded on 30 October (early band, inside its deadline)
loan recorded on its own deadline, 23 October
the read-back names both dates

coverage_limits: 13 public cases do not estimate hidden score.
50 synthetic planning cases are not registered hosted fixtures.
A correct bank write does not prove policy or conversation-order compliance.
One green run does not prove repeatability.
development_layers: hosted public cases, repetitions and speaking-style variants
budget_policy: Use targeted smoke/regression tests within each final build; broad repeated evaluation is development work.
